checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One finished 16:9 thumbnail with large tired face
must.why: Large exhausted man with dark circles, slack mouth, lit by phone.
STOP SCROLLING. SLEEP. is three words, spelled correctly.
Directly about stopping scrolling and sleeping.
Thick white and yellow caps on dark navy; very legible.

must.item: Face and headline unobstructed, not awkwardly cropped
must.why: Text is clear. The top of the hair is slightly cropped, which is minor. The phone covers only the lower chin area.

faults.what: Hair is cropped slightly at the top edge. The phone and hand overlap the lower face and bottom edge.
Face is somewhat dim and blends into the dark background, so it is less punchy against the navy than the text.
The headline has no black outline as described, though it remains readable.

summary: A strong, legible 16:9 thumbnail with a correctly spelled three-word headline and a big, convincingly tired face, with only minor cropping and dimness issues.
